action.command: cd /workspace/deployment && docker logs qonnectra_backend_dev 2>&1 | grep -iE "migrat|superuser|error|traceback|Initial data" | tail -20; echo "=== db tables ==="; docker exec qonnectra_db_dev psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1; echo "=== postgis/pgrouting ==="; docker exec qonnectra_db_dev psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT extname FROM pg_extension ORDER BY 1;" 2>&1; echo "=== superuser ==="; docker exec qonnectra_db_dev psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT username, is_superuser FROM auth_user;" 2>&1
